cta-order-plan.description: Persist integer net-lot plans with close-before-open dependencies; do not accept stock weights.

cta-order-precheck.description: Check the latest contract, session, dependencies and resources without freezing.

cta-order-submit.description: Revalidate a persisted plan leg and atomically register and freeze resources.

cta-order-cancel.description: Cancel remaining lots and release resources while preserving actual fills.

cta-execution-simulate.description: Advance one completed futures bar through matching, booking and release.

cta-order-query.description: Read order, fills, reservations and account reconciliation status.

cta-daily-settle.description: Apply explicit-price daily marked-to-market settlement and day migration.

cta-roll-plan.description: Persist linked old-close/new-open plans; plans do not imply executed progress.

cta-contract-spec.description: Read the configured contract and trade-date rule profile.

cta-trading-session.description: Resolve an explicit calendar interval to a trading day, including night sessions.

cta-position-gap.description: Read gross positions and active open/close leaves to calculate signed net-lot gap.

cta-offset-split.description: Calculate side and today/yesterday closing splits followed by opening lots.

cta-order-rule-check.description: Read authoritative rules and resources to validate a persisted plan leg; do not freeze.

cta-margin-calculate.description: Calculate explicit RATE or FIXED margin and notional; do not book money.

cta-fee-calculate.description: Calculate per-lot or notional incremental fees using the explicit offset.

cta-order-register.description: Atomically register and freeze one validated persisted plan leg.

cta-order-release.description: Release only excess resources justified by persisted remaining lots and fills.

cta-order-match.description: Calculate a conservative opening-price candidate; do not occupy capacity or book.

cta-fill-record.description: Recompute from a persisted market event and atomically record a fill and occupy capacity.

cta-order-state-update.description: Apply a persisted fill or versioned cancellation to order quantities only.

cta-fill-book.description: Idempotently book an existing applied fill, fees, realized PnL and lot claims.

cta-order-detail.description: Read current order, fills, reservations and accounting status without mutation.

cta-settlement-apply.description: Book only incremental daily holding PnL and migrate lot buckets once.

cta-roll-progress.description: Read actual booked old-close/new-open lots and unconnected exposure.
